title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Solo #16 (대각 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: French woman, an adult, in her mid 50s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real pores, real living eyes, 50 segment rings piercings set with a mix of diamonds, pearls and sapphires in bronze-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of rose-gold a hair ornament. Full body painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 41% of the way down her figure from the top and about 72% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, with optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
